value.main_text_excerpt:
OUR VISION
Torvald Klaveness has challenged the status quo for almost 80 years. The success and legacy of the company is anchored in finding new ways to improve technology and business models in shipping.
Our vision of improving the nature of shipping underpins the work we do and our continuous commitment to change and improve the industry we are a part of.
OUR BUSINESSES
Klaveness Combination Carriers ASA
Torvald Klaveness is the main shareholder of Klaveness Combination Carriers ASA, a company listed on the Oslo Stock Exchange (ticker: “KCC”).
The fleet of 19 combination carriers mainly operate in optimized trade patterns, switching between dry and wet cargoes with minimum ballast. As a result, the fleet delivers up to 40% lower greenhouse gas emissions compared to conventional dry bulk and tanker vessels performing the same transport work.
Klaveness Digital
Klaveness Digital AS, a company fully owned by Torvald Klaveness, is responsible for the innovation process, and the development and commercialization of digital services across the Klaveness Group.
They deliver real-time insights that help companies navigate complexity, reduce risk, and improve efficiency across their supply chains and commercial operations.
Klaveness Dry Bulk
Klaveness Dry Bulk, 75% owned by Torvald Klaveness, is a leading operator in the global dry bulk industry and manages the world’s largest Panamax Pool. 
They enable customers and partners to navigate market volatility, optimize performance, and create lasting value by combining innovative business models, strategic partnerships, and digital solutions.

pages.main_text_excerpt:
COMPLIANCE
Klaveness strives to shape the future standards of compliance in global shipping
- 
      
        
          Our Code of Conduct defines our core legal and ethical standards and applies to all Klaveness directors, officers and employees, both on shore and on board our vessels. The code provides a framework for Klaveness’ governance, and defines the most important principles and ethical norms that form the basis for how we create value in Klaveness and conduct our business. These principles and values are implemented in our governance documents.
- 
      
        
      
      Our Counterparty Code of Conduct defines the core legal and ethical standards we expect from our subcontractors, contractual counterparties and others we do business with. The code applies to all our contractual relationships through standard documents and clauses.
- 
      
        
      
      Torvald Klaveness promotes a culture of openness and transparency. This is important for both the overall work environment and the well-being of the individual employee. Moreover, it is a key to optimal business operations. We therefore encourage whistleblowing regarding blameworthy activities or circumstances within our business. Employees and others who have reason to believe that there are blameworthy activities or circumstances (e.g. breach of applicable legislation) within our business have the right to and are encouraged to whistleblow. The same applies if they have reason to believe that there is a violation of Klaveness Code of Conduct. Employees who give notification in accordance with Section 2-4 of the Norwegian Working Environment Act and Klaveness Guidelines for Whistleblowing shall be protected against any unfavorable treatment as a reaction to the whistleblowing (“retaliation”). You can choose to be anonymous. In such case you will automatically be given a username and password so that you can log in to see the status of your case and securely communicate with the case handler. At any stage during the case handling you may also choose to reveal your identity.
-

pages.main_text_excerpt:
GOVERNANCE
Klaveness believes transparent and good corporate governance drives value creation by aligning stakeholder and company interests
The main governance structure and principles are as follows:
- Trond Harald Klaveness is the sole owner and Chair of the Board of Rederiaksjeselskapet Torvald Klaveness (RASTK). The RASTK Board of Directors further comprises independent representatives with extensive corporate experience, Christian Rynning-Tønnesen, Rebekka Glasser Herlofsen, Elisabeth Tørstad, and Mehrdad Amini.
- Ernst Meyer is the President and CEO of Torvald Klaveness and heads up Klaveness Holding and the Klaveness Executive Committee.
- Torvald Klaveness has incorporated a holding structure with a top management team responsible for developing and implementing corporate strategy, execute active ownership of the existing portfolio of companies, drive new strategic investments, and actively manage a portfolio of liquid financial investments.
- The Group's portfolio companies include Klaveness Digital (100% owned), Klaveness Dry Bulk (75% owned by Klaveness and 25% owned by Marubeni Corporation), and Klaveness Combination Carriers (KCC), in which Klaveness holds approximately 44% of the shares. KCC is listed on the Oslo Stock Exchange.
- KCC and KDB are governed through separate Boards of Directors, these consist of board representatives from the Holding team and external directors.
- Company headquarters are Oslo, Norway, with subsidiaries operating in Singapore, Japan, Manila, and Dubai.
- Safety, Risk Management, Compliance, Cyber-security, Human Rights and ESG in general are integral parts of our business. We have dedicated people, functions, policies, governance, and management attention in place to execute safe and responsible business practices. Our compliance program is mandatory for all employees, officers, and directors.
- We operate under a Code of Conduct that is accepted in writing by each employee, officer, and director.

pages.main_text_excerpt:
CAREERS
Keen to make a difference?
Join us on a journey to improve the nature of shipping
What we are looking for
We seek to attract and retain the best people and make sure they can reach their full potential.
We believe in, and encourage, long term professional and personal growth. We strive to build strong communities where people commit themselves, challenge each other, and where we develop together.
A team member of Klaveness is passionate, up for challenges, and willing to explore the boundaries of their own comfort zone. We believe this is key in today’s knowledge economy and fundamental in our commitment to challenge the status quo and bring new opportunities to deep-sea shipping.
Klaveness Academy
Equipping our employees with the right skills and tools, at the right time is essential. We value growth and foster a culture of learning and development that encourage our pioneers to become the best versions of themselves.
To meet this need, we have developed our very own educational hub - Klaveness Academy. We believe in lifelong learning and the Academy offers just that through three main programs:
- Decarbonization by Klaveness Academy
- The Klaveness Analytics program
- The Klaveness Compliance program
We are always looking for talented people who are driven by success, innovation, and self-development to join our team. We value diversity and depend on a wide spectrum of competence across the business to fulfil our everyday needs.
As a member of the Klaveness team, you will be passionate about creating sustainable solutions for our own operations as well as those of our customers. You will apply cutting edge technology and digital solutions to employ data driven decisions in all areas of our business. You will contribute to decarbonizing global shipping and play a key role in one of the biggest challenges of this generation.
Starting your journey with Klaveness today will see you join an ambition to make seaborne supply chains, resilient, decarbonized, and cost-effective.

Vacancy in Manila with Klaveness Shore Services, Inc. (KSSI)
With great ambitions, we need great people!
Klaveness Shore Services, Inc. (KSSI) is currently seeking to fill a challenging role in its Finance Department. KSSI is a PEZA registered IT Export Enterprise, engaged in the business of providing outsourcing services and business process outsourcing services, specifically accounting, information technology, and commercial operations to shipping enterprises, organizations, entities and companies in the foreign market
About the role:
The Senior Accountant is generally responsible for preparation of various governmental reportorial requirements and ensures that deliverables are met with high quality and standards, and timely. That includes, but not limited to, preparing Financial Statements, Tax Return, and other reports to PEZA, BIR, SEC, etc. The position serves as support to the Corporate Accounting Manager in matters like accounting and tax issues, routines and guidelines, and process improvements.
Job Responsibilities:
- Assist in the preparation of the Financial Statements.
- Responsible for preparation of Tax Returns, including filing and payment.
- Responsible for preparation of reportorial requirements to government agencies (BIR, PEZA, SEC and others).
- Provides reports as per requirement of client and/or other concerned parties and ensures adherence to client's accounting reporting policies and procedures.
- Ensures timely processing of accounts-related matters for closing activities.
- Performs account reconciliation for accounts related to tax and governmental reportorial reports.
- Provides guidance to the team in solving accounting matters and proper accounting treatment.
- Provides guidance to the team to ensure proper internal control procedures and routines.
- Ensures all accounting treatment, processes and workflows comply with the accounting standards and company policies; reviews to maintain a robust accounting process.
- Coordinates with internal and external customers as necessary.
- Coordinates with internal and external auditors on audit requirements.
- Liaise with various stakeholders (Group Finance, Treasury & Risk, Operations, etc) on accounting matters as necessary.
- Initiates and participates in various improvement projects.
- Maintains and keeps supporting documents in digital form and properly filed at all times.
- Complies with KSSI administration policies and guidelines in performance of work assignments.
- Liaise with BIR, PEZA, SEC. and other government agencies in handling LOA, processing of permits and licenses and the likes.
- Performs other tasks that may be assigned from time to time that are necessary for service efficiency to the Client and to support department/company goals and objectives.
- Directly communicates with Group Finance, Treasury and other stakeholders.
- Coordinates with auditor for reportorial requirements and communication on relevant issues.
- Oversees team and deliverables in absence of Accounting Manager.
Qualifications:
- Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Certified Public Accountant (CPA)
- At least 5 years of tax and accounting experience, preferably with some experience from corporate/local accounting
- Knowledgeable in local accounting, finances and taxation
- Basic knowledge in using SAP or related high end financial reporting tool
- Knowledgeable in MS Office products, especially MS Excel
- Works flexible, analytical and a contributor to the team
- Able to work independently and proactively
- Analytical with keen attention to details and accuracy
- Ability to meet deadlines and has sense of priority
- Considerable degree of analysis for problem-solving and judgement
- Strong interpersonal and supervisorial skills
- Good written and oral English communication skills
- Good work ethics with strong internal customer focus
- Matured and have a developed cross cultural mind set
We offer a challenging position in an international company with great ambitions for the future based on digitization and innovation:
- European modern Company with long traditions within Shipping
- Part of a dedicated team of professionals working with global clients
- Fast paced working environment in modern office in Five Ecom Center, Harbor Drive, MOA Complex, Pasay City
We offer a role in our KSSI team in Manila, an integral part of an international and progressive company with great ambitions for the future. With us, you will experience good opportunities for personal and professional development, and we offer nice and collaborative working environment in our office at Five Ecom Center in Pasay City.
If all this sounds like a great opportunity to you, please submit your application through the link below.

We are looking for an active student with maritime and shipping interests for an exciting, challenging and different summer internship for the summer of 2027.
The internship will start at the head office in Oslo with an introduction to the Torvald Klaveness group, Klaveness Combination Carriers (KCC) and Klaveness Ship Management by OSM Thome (KSM), and preparations for sailing and life onboard.
The next 6-10 weeks will be on board one of KCC’s globally trading combination carriers. The student will receive a defined training program spanning over all the departments and systems when onboard, and the candidate will also be involved in specific projects from the HQ in Oslo to be followed up from the vessel. The specific vessel will be selected based on the fleets’ schedule and trading pattern.
The right candidate must be genuinely interested in learning from practical experience, show interest and respect for other cultures, and in general be positive and open to challenges underway. The candidate must have completed the 2nd year or higher of an integrated master program in engineering, alternatively have succeeded in acquiring a bachelor’s degree in engineering and is entering a Master program.
Post your written application including a 1-minute video, as well as your latest grades, by 1 November 2026 by using this link: https://nuu.no/torvald_klaveness/stilling/24882
For any questions regarding the internship please contact:
Jean Sissener
Manager, Strategy & Business Development
Klaveness Combination Carriers
+47 917 73 566
About Torvald Klaveness:
Torvald Klaveness is a pioneering shipping group with a vision to improve the nature of shipping. Through its portfolio companies, Klaveness helps customers move cargo more efficiently by combining maritime expertise, innovative shipping solutions, and digital capabilities. Together, these solutions increase trading efficiency and support more resilient, decarbonized, and cost-effective seaborne supply chains.
Klaveness Holding oversees the group’s ownership interests and investments. Klaveness Combination Carriers, listed on the Oslo Stock Exchange, owns and operates a fleet of combination carriers, Klaveness Dry Bulk is a leading global dry bulk operator and manager of the world’s largest Panamax pool, and Klaveness Digital develops digital solutions for seaborne supply chains and chartering decision support.
Klaveness Ship Management by OSM Thome manages the owned vessels from an environmental, technical, and commercial standpoint.
With 80 years of experience, Klaveness operates approximately 75 vessels and employs around 155 people across offices in Oslo, Singapore, Manila, Dubai and Tokyo.

pages.main_text_excerpt:
Part 8 of an 8-part story through the decades to mark our 80th anniversary
As Klaveness entered its eighth decade, the direction set during the previous period began to take shape. The combination carrier business prepared to enter new markets, digital initiatives moved closer to customers, and the foundations of the Klaveness business we know today was beginning to emerge.
Over the next ten years, many of these initiatives would evolve into focused businesses in their own right. New partnerships were formed, new capabilities were developed and a clearer picture began to take shape of where Klaveness could create the greatest value for customers.
A new generation of combination carriers
In 2018, Klaveness Combination Carriers was established as a separate company and began trading on the Norwegian stock exchange, creating a dedicated platform for the combination carrier business and its continued development.
At the same time, KCC was preparing to enter new markets. The following year, MV Baru became the first of eight CLEANBU vessels to enter service. The new generation extended the combination carrier concept into clean petroleum products while retaining the ability to carry dry bulk cargoes.
While the CLEANBUs expanded the concept into new trades, development of the original CABU business continued. Alongside this, KCC embarked on an ambitious energy efficiency project to further improve the carbon footprint of its fleet, and cement its position as a global leader in low-carbon deep-sea shipping in the tanker and dry bulk segment. The decade closed with the delivery of three third-generation CABU vessels in 2026, representing the latest evolution of the combination carrier concept first introduced at the start of the new millennium.
From a digitalized Klaveness to Klaveness Digital
What began as an experiment to explore how technology and data could improve shipping gradually developed into solutions with real value to customers. CargoValue was developed as a commercial software platform to help industrial customers improve coordination across complex seaborne supply chains. In 2017, Klaveness Digital was established as a separate company, initially built around that single product.
At the same time, new digital capabilities were emerging elsewhere in the group. Klaveness Dry Bulk developed tools to improve freight decisions and commercial performance, while an initiative called ZeroLab explored how technology and new business models could help customers meet the challenge of decarbonization.
Over time, these efforts increasingly came together within Klaveness Digital. What began as a single software solution evolved into a broader digital business, developing and commercializing tools that help customers make better decisions and improve supply chain performance.
New partnerships and investments
In its dry bulk business, Klaveness increasingly focused on the areas where it believed it could create the greatest value for customers: building long-term partnerships, developing innovative pool solutions, and using data and technology to support better commercial decisions.
That direction was reinforced in 2020 through the partnership with Marubeni Corporation to operate the Baumarine Panamax pool, which entered a new phase in 2023 when Marubeni acquired a 25% stake in Klaveness Dry Bulk.
The wider Klaveness portfolio was also being reshaped. Some activities were sold, and new partnerships were formed as Klaveness increasingly focused its resources on the areas where it believed it could create the greatest long-term value. To support this approach, a dedicated investment team and holding structure were established to provide active ownership and support the continued development of the group's businesses.
Klaveness was no longer one company pursuing many different activities. It was increasingly becoming a group of focused businesses, each developing a distinct role.
Defining a shared direction: trading efficiency
From our first steps in 1946 to marking our 80th anniversary in 2026, Torvald Klaveness has evolved into a group spanning combination carriers, dry bulk shipping, digital services and strategic investments. While each business has a distinct role, they remain connected by a common ambition: finding better ways to create value for customers and improve the efficiency of seaborne trade.
The next 10 years will see our concept of trading efficiency increasingly provide the direction for how we approach the challenges facing our industry. Building on deep maritime expertise, innovative shipping solutions and digital capabilities, we will continue to develop businesses and services designed to support more resilient, decarbonized and cost-effective supply chains.

value.main_text_excerpt:
OUR VISION
Torvald Klaveness has challenged the status quo for almost 80 years. The success and legacy of the company is anchored in finding new ways to improve technology and business models in shipping.
Our vision of improving the nature of shipping underpins the work we do and our continuous commitment to change and improve the industry we are a part of.
OUR BUSINESSES
Klaveness Combination Carriers ASA
Torvald Klaveness is the main shareholder of Klaveness Combination Carriers ASA, a company listed on the Oslo Stock Exchange (ticker: “KCC”).
The fleet of 19 combination carriers mainly operate in optimized trade patterns, switching between dry and wet cargoes with minimum ballast. As a result, the fleet delivers up to 40% lower greenhouse gas emissions compared to conventional dry bulk and tanker vessels performing the same transport work.
Klaveness Digital
Klaveness Digital AS, a company fully owned by Torvald Klaveness, is responsible for the innovation process, and the development and commercialization of digital services across the Klaveness Group.
They deliver real-time insights that help companies navigate complexity, reduce risk, and improve efficiency across their supply chains and commercial operations.
Klaveness Dry Bulk
Klaveness Dry Bulk, 75% owned by Torvald Klaveness, is a leading operator in the global dry bulk industry and manages the world’s largest Panamax Pool. 
They enable customers and partners to navigate market volatility, optimize performance, and create lasting value by combining innovative business models, strategic partnerships, and digital solutions.

pages.main_text_excerpt:
COMPLIANCE
Klaveness strives to shape the future standards of compliance in global shipping
- 
      
        
          Our Code of Conduct defines our core legal and ethical standards and applies to all Klaveness directors, officers and employees, both on shore and on board our vessels. The code provides a framework for Klaveness’ governance, and defines the most important principles and ethical norms that form the basis for how we create value in Klaveness and conduct our business. These principles and values are implemented in our governance documents.
- 
      
        
      
      Our Counterparty Code of Conduct defines the core legal and ethical standards we expect from our subcontractors, contractual counterparties and others we do business with. The code applies to all our contractual relationships through standard documents and clauses.
- 
      
        
      
      Torvald Klaveness promotes a culture of openness and transparency. This is important for both the overall work environment and the well-being of the individual employee. Moreover, it is a key to optimal business operations. We therefore encourage whistleblowing regarding blameworthy activities or circumstances within our business. Employees and others who have reason to believe that there are blameworthy activities or circumstances (e.g. breach of applicable legislation) within our business have the right to and are encouraged to whistleblow. The same applies if they have reason to believe that there is a violation of Klaveness Code of Conduct. Employees who give notification in accordance with Section 2-4 of the Norwegian Working Environment Act and Klaveness Guidelines for Whistleblowing shall be protected against any unfavorable treatment as a reaction to the whistleblowing (“retaliation”). You can choose to be anonymous. In such case you will automatically be given a username and password so that you can log in to see the status of your case and securely communicate with the case handler. At any stage during the case handling you may also choose to reveal your identity.
-

pages.main_text_excerpt:
GOVERNANCE
Klaveness believes transparent and good corporate governance drives value creation by aligning stakeholder and company interests
The main governance structure and principles are as follows:
- Trond Harald Klaveness is the sole owner and Chair of the Board of Rederiaksjeselskapet Torvald Klaveness (RASTK). The RASTK Board of Directors further comprises independent representatives with extensive corporate experience, Christian Rynning-Tønnesen, Rebekka Glasser Herlofsen, Elisabeth Tørstad, and Mehrdad Amini.
- Ernst Meyer is the President and CEO of Torvald Klaveness and heads up Klaveness Holding and the Klaveness Executive Committee.
- Torvald Klaveness has incorporated a holding structure with a top management team responsible for developing and implementing corporate strategy, execute active ownership of the existing portfolio of companies, drive new strategic investments, and actively manage a portfolio of liquid financial investments.
- The Group's portfolio companies include Klaveness Digital (100% owned), Klaveness Dry Bulk (75% owned by Klaveness and 25% owned by Marubeni Corporation), and Klaveness Combination Carriers (KCC), in which Klaveness holds approximately 44% of the shares. KCC is listed on the Oslo Stock Exchange.
- KCC and KDB are governed through separate Boards of Directors, these consist of board representatives from the Holding team and external directors.
- Company headquarters are Oslo, Norway, with subsidiaries operating in Singapore, Japan, Manila, and Dubai.
- Safety, Risk Management, Compliance, Cyber-security, Human Rights and ESG in general are integral parts of our business. We have dedicated people, functions, policies, governance, and management attention in place to execute safe and responsible business practices. Our compliance program is mandatory for all employees, officers, and directors.
- We operate under a Code of Conduct that is accepted in writing by each employee, officer, and director.

CAREERS
Keen to make a difference?
Join us on a journey to improve the nature of shipping
What we are looking for
We seek to attract and retain the best people and make sure they can reach their full potential.
We believe in, and encourage, long term professional and personal growth. We strive to build strong communities where people commit themselves, challenge each other, and where we develop together.
A team member of Klaveness is passionate, up for challenges, and willing to explore the boundaries of their own comfort zone. We believe this is key in today’s knowledge economy and fundamental in our commitment to challenge the status quo and bring new opportunities to deep-sea shipping.
Klaveness Academy
Equipping our employees with the right skills and tools, at the right time is essential. We value growth and foster a culture of learning and development that encourage our pioneers to become the best versions of themselves.
To meet this need, we have developed our very own educational hub - Klaveness Academy. We believe in lifelong learning and the Academy offers just that through three main programs:
- Decarbonization by Klaveness Academy
- The Klaveness Analytics program
- The Klaveness Compliance program
We are always looking for talented people who are driven by success, innovation, and self-development to join our team. We value diversity and depend on a wide spectrum of competence across the business to fulfil our everyday needs.
As a member of the Klaveness team, you will be passionate about creating sustainable solutions for our own operations as well as those of our customers. You will apply cutting edge technology and digital solutions to employ data driven decisions in all areas of our business. You will contribute to decarbonizing global shipping and play a key role in one of the biggest challenges of this generation.
Starting your journey with Klaveness today will see you join an ambition to make seaborne supply chains, resilient, decarbonized, and cost-effective.

We are looking for an active student with maritime and shipping interests for an exciting, challenging and different summer internship for the summer of 2027.
The internship will start at the head office in Oslo with an introduction to the Torvald Klaveness group, Klaveness Combination Carriers (KCC) and Klaveness Ship Management by OSM Thome (KSM), and preparations for sailing and life onboard.
The next 6-10 weeks will be on board one of KCC’s globally trading combination carriers. The student will receive a defined training program spanning over all the departments and systems when onboard, and the candidate will also be involved in specific projects from the HQ in Oslo to be followed up from the vessel. The specific vessel will be selected based on the fleets’ schedule and trading pattern.
The right candidate must be genuinely interested in learning from practical experience, show interest and respect for other cultures, and in general be positive and open to challenges underway. The candidate must have completed the 2nd year or higher of an integrated master program in engineering, alternatively have succeeded in acquiring a bachelor’s degree in engineering and is entering a Master program.
Post your written application including a 1-minute video, as well as your latest grades, by 1 November 2026 by using this link: https://nuu.no/torvald_klaveness/stilling/24882
For any questions regarding the internship please contact:
Jean Sissener
Manager, Strategy & Business Development
Klaveness Combination Carriers

About Torvald Klaveness:
Torvald Klaveness is a pioneering shipping group with a vision to improve the nature of shipping. Through its portfolio companies, Klaveness helps customers move cargo more efficiently by combining maritime expertise, innovative shipping solutions, and digital capabilities. Together, these solutions increase trading efficiency and support more resilient, decarbonized, and cost-effective seaborne supply chains.
Klaveness Holding oversees the group’s ownership interests and investments. Klaveness Combination Carriers, listed on the Oslo Stock Exchange, owns and operates a fleet of combination carriers, Klaveness Dry Bulk is a leading global dry bulk operator and manager of the world’s largest Panamax pool, and Klaveness Digital develops digital solutions for seaborne supply chains and chartering decision support.
Klaveness Ship Management by OSM Thome manages the owned vessels from an environmental, technical, and commercial standpoint.
With 80 years of experience, Klaveness operates approximately 75 vessels and employs around 155 people across offices in Oslo, Singapore, Manila, Dubai and Tokyo.

pages.main_text_excerpt:
Part 8 of an 8-part story through the decades to mark our 80th anniversary
As Klaveness entered its eighth decade, the direction set during the previous period began to take shape. The combination carrier business prepared to enter new markets, digital initiatives moved closer to customers, and the foundations of the Klaveness business we know today was beginning to emerge.
Over the next ten years, many of these initiatives would evolve into focused businesses in their own right. New partnerships were formed, new capabilities were developed and a clearer picture began to take shape of where Klaveness could create the greatest value for customers.
A new generation of combination carriers
In 2018, Klaveness Combination Carriers was established as a separate company and began trading on the Norwegian stock exchange, creating a dedicated platform for the combination carrier business and its continued development.
At the same time, KCC was preparing to enter new markets. The following year, MV Baru became the first of eight CLEANBU vessels to enter service. The new generation extended the combination carrier concept into clean petroleum products while retaining the ability to carry dry bulk cargoes.
While the CLEANBUs expanded the concept into new trades, development of the original CABU business continued. Alongside this, KCC embarked on an ambitious energy efficiency project to further improve the carbon footprint of its fleet, and cement its position as a global leader in low-carbon deep-sea shipping in the tanker and dry bulk segment. The decade closed with the delivery of three third-generation CABU vessels in 2026, representing the latest evolution of the combination carrier concept first introduced at the start of the new millennium.
From a digitalized Klaveness to Klaveness Digital
What began as an experiment to explore how technology and data could improve shipping gradually developed into solutions with real value to customers. CargoValue was developed as a commercial software platform to help industrial customers improve coordination across complex seaborne supply chains. In 2017, Klaveness Digital was established as a separate company, initially built around that single product.
At the same time, new digital capabilities were emerging elsewhere in the group. Klaveness Dry Bulk developed tools to improve freight decisions and commercial performance, while an initiative called ZeroLab explored how technology and new business models could help customers meet the challenge of decarbonization.
Over time, these efforts increasingly came together within Klaveness Digital. What began as a single software solution evolved into a broader digital business, developing and commercializing tools that help customers make better decisions and improve supply chain performance.
New partnerships and investments
In its dry bulk business, Klaveness increasingly focused on the areas where it believed it could create the greatest value for customers: building long-term partnerships, developing innovative pool solutions, and using data and technology to support better commercial decisions.
That direction was reinforced in 2020 through the partnership with Marubeni Corporation to operate the Baumarine Panamax pool, which entered a new phase in 2023 when Marubeni acquired a 25% stake in Klaveness Dry Bulk.
The wider Klaveness portfolio was also being reshaped. Some activities were sold, and new partnerships were formed as Klaveness increasingly focused its resources on the areas where it believed it could create the greatest long-term value. To support this approach, a dedicated investment team and holding structure were established to provide active ownership and support the continued development of the group's businesses.
Klaveness was no longer one company pursuing many different activities. It was increasingly becoming a group of focused businesses, each developing a distinct role.
Defining a shared direction: trading efficiency
From our first steps in 1946 to marking our 80th anniversary in 2026, Torvald Klaveness has evolved into a group spanning combination carriers, dry bulk shipping, digital services and strategic investments. While each business has a distinct role, they remain connected by a common ambition: finding better ways to create value for customers and improve the efficiency of seaborne trade.
The next 10 years will see our concept of trading efficiency increasingly provide the direction for how we approach the challenges facing our industry. Building on deep maritime expertise, innovative shipping solutions and digital capabilities, we will continue to develop businesses and services designed to support more resilient, decarbonized and cost-effective supply chains.
